findings.title: No extension/plugin contract or versioned public API surface
findings.note: packages/sdk exists but no plugin/extension API or deprecation policy.
findings.impact: Third-party integrations lack a stable contract.
findings.recommendation: Document a versioning/deprecation policy and an extension contract.

report:
Reviewed the route registry, SDK package and
feature-flag module for extension points. No public plugin/webhook-inbound API
beyond outbound webhooks.
